subject.title: feat(feeds): serve signed catalog queries and changes

question: Should ClawHub adopt these signed query and change endpoints as the supported public catalog-feed contract once the signing and distribution-state predecessors land?
rationale: This is a new externally consumable transport contract with rollout, compatibility, retention, and signing-boundary consequences; tests cannot choose the long-term product/API direction.

options.title: Approve the staged transport contract
options.body: Accept the query and change endpoints as the next public catalog-feed layer, contingent on predecessor landing order and redacted live proof.

options.title: Keep only the unsigned snapshot contract
options.body: Do not add signed query/change transport until a narrower consumer-backed API proposal is approved.

options.title: Request a narrower producer contract
options.body: Approve only the endpoint subset and cursor semantics maintainers are prepared to support as a stable public API.

recommendation.title: Approve the staged transport contract
recommendation.body: Accept the query and change endpoints as the next public catalog-feed layer, contingent on predecessor landing order and redacted live proof.

likelyOwner.reason: This contributor has carried the documented feed-stack slices and can provide the technical contract context, while final acceptance remains a repository maintainer decision.
